title: Headache (Recurrent) — Stock-aware
source: Doctorwalah OPD Gold Edition — Headache (Recurrent) + clinic inventory

medicines.label: Tromanil Plus — nimesulide 100 mg + paracetamol 325 mg
medicines.dose: Pack: as directed by physician; pack warning states nimesulide use should ordinarily be restricted to 10 days.
medicines.duration: Short-term; do not exceed 10 days for nimesulide-containing product per pack warning
medicines.instruction: Use only when clinically appropriate for the documented headache pattern; review liver/GI/renal risk and avoid duplicate NSAID/paracetamol products.

note: The OPD reference for recurrent tension-type headache lists paracetamol 650 mg, amitriptyline 10 mg HS and pantoprazole 40 mg. Only the stocked medicine that directly documents severe headache/migraine use is auto-matched here; amitriptyline is not substituted with another antidepressant.

title: Fever / Acute Febrile Illness — Stock-aware
source: Clinic protocol: Fever / Acute Febrile Illness + clinic inventory use fields

medicines.label: Nimucaff Plus — nimesulide 100 mg + paracetamol 325 mg
medicines.dose: Label: as directed by physician; use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration.
medicines.instruction: Use only when an NSAID-containing combination is clinically appropriate and dengue/other contraindications have been considered. Avoid duplicate paracetamol/NSAID products and review liver, renal and GI risk.

note: The source pathway is supportive and does not treat fever alone as proof of bacterial infection. A plain adult paracetamol product is not currently recorded in the GitHub starter inventory, so this stocked combination is only an inventory-based option.
